purpose: Permit a provisional reference orientation under explicit partial classification without coercing undefined orientations to FALSE.

constraints: Omega_x_pos, Omega_x_neg, and Omega_x_undef are pairwise disjoint.
Every membership classification retains its AdmObs_x provenance.

Resolution_x.meaning: A total completion of the partial AdmObs_x classification.

PermittedResolution_x.signature: PermittedResolution_x(P_x, rho_x; H_x, B_x, D_rel, R) : Prop
conditions: rho_x(o)=TRUE for every o in Omega_x_pos.
rho_x(o)=FALSE for every o in Omega_x_neg.
rho_x assigns only TRUE or FALSE to every o in Omega_x_undef.
Assignments to Omega_x_undef satisfy pointwise admissibility under the declared domain, boundary, and residue constraints.
F_x satisfies JointlyCompatible_x(F_x; H_x, B_x, D_rel, R).
rho_x does not revise an established positive or negative classification.

RefDetermines_x.signature: RefDetermines_x(RefRule_x, rho_x, o_x; B_x, D_rel, R) : Prop
RefDetermines_x.policy: The strong form is required when downstream output is one reference orientation rather than a set of possible reference orientations.

resolution_space: Res_x(P_x; H_x, B_x, D_rel, R) := {rho_x | PermittedResolution_x(P_x, rho_x; H_x, B_x, D_rel, R)}

resolution_requirements.pointwise: Every unresolved orientation receives a binary value satisfying PointwiseResolutionCompatible_x.
resolution_requirements.joint: The completed family satisfies GlobalJointCoherence_x across all jointly assigned orientations.
resolution_requirements.boundary: The completion remains compatible with B_x.
resolution_requirements.residue: The completion remains compatible with R.
resolution_requirements.totality: Every rho_x in Res_x is total over Omega_obs.

CompletedOrientationFamily_x.signature: CompletedOrientationFamily_x(P_x, rho_x) := { (o, rho_x(o)) | o in P_x.Omega_obs }
CompletedOrientationFamily_x.meaning: The total TRUE/FALSE orientation assignment produced by a proposed resolution.
CompletedOrientationFamily_x.totality_guard: rho_x must be total over P_x.Omega_obs.

FamilyConstraintSet_x.scope_rule: Each h declares its required arity or full-family scope.
FamilyConstraintSet_x.empty_constraint_policy: Only an explicitly declared empty H_x makes HigherOrderCompatible_x definitionally satisfied; an absent constraint definition remains unresolved.

BinaryOrientationConstraintSet_x.member_signature: b : (Orientation_x x Bool) x (Orientation_x x Bool) -> Prop

OrientationFamily_x.meaning: A declared family F of observation orientations together with its binary classification and retained provenance.
structural_conditions: F is a subfamily of Omega_obs.
rho_x is defined on every member of F.
Each member retains its AdmObs_x classification provenance.

AdmissibleOrientationFamily_x.signature: AdmissibleOrientationFamily_x(F, rho_x; P_x, B_x, D_rel, R) : Prop
AdmissibleOrientationFamily_x.definition: F is an admissible orientation family when it is within Omega_obs, its classification is total on F, every member satisfies pointwise compatibility, and the family satisfies JointlyCompatible_x under B_x, D_rel, and R.
required_conditions: F is a subfamily of Omega_obs.
Every member of F satisfies PointwiseResolutionCompatible_x.
JointlyCompatible_x(F; BCon_x, H_x, B_x, D_rel, R) holds.
Boundary, domain, residue, and provenance constraints are retained.
AdmissibleOrientationFamily_x.empty_family_guard: An empty admissible family is a failure of bounded realization under the declared scope, not symmetry annihilation.

PointwiseResolutionCompatible_x.signature: PointwiseResolutionCompatible_x(o, rho_x; P_x, B_x, D_rel, R) : Prop
PointwiseResolutionCompatible_x.definition: For o in Omega_x_pos, rho_x(o)=TRUE; for o in Omega_x_neg, rho_x(o)=FALSE; for o in Omega_x_undef, rho_x(o) is binary and satisfies the declared boundary, domain, and residue compatibility conditions.
guards: It does not revise a defined TRUE or FALSE classification.
It does not treat UNDEFINED as FALSE.
It is evaluated before RefOrient and ProjectBounded.

GlobalJointCoherence_x.signature: GlobalJointCoherence_x(F_x; H_x, B_x, D_rel, R) : Prop
GlobalJointCoherence_x.definition: The complete binary assignment rho_x is jointly realizable under the declared boundary interaction, relational domain, residue, and family-level orientation compatibility constraint JointlyCompatible_x.
required_conditions: Every pointwise assignment in F_x satisfies PointwiseResolutionCompatible_x.
JointlyCompatible_x(F_x; H_x, B_x, D_rel, R) holds.
The completed family remains compatible with B_x, D_rel, and R.
No jointly impossible family is admitted merely because each member passes pointwise evaluation.

JointlyCompatible_x.signature: JointlyCompatible_x(F_x; BCon_x, H_x, B_x, D_rel, R) : Prop
JointlyCompatible_x.definition: PairwiseCompatible_x(F_x; BCon_x, B_x, D_rel, R) AND HigherOrderCompatible_x(F_x; H_x, B_x, D_rel, R).
JointlyCompatible_x.role: Primary cross-orientation compatibility relation used by GlobalJointCoherence_x.
JointlyCompatible_x.pairwise_guard: A pairwise relation may be a necessary subcondition, but pairwise compatibility alone is not assumed sufficient for joint compatibility.
JointlyCompatible_x.higher_order_component: JointConstraint_x(F_x; BCon_x, H_x, B_x, D_rel, R) may impose constraints on the family as a whole.

PairwiseCompatible_x.signature: PairwiseCompatible_x(F_x; BCon_x, B_x, D_rel, R) : Prop
PairwiseCompatible_x.definition: For every distinct assigned pair in F_x, the pair satisfies every applicable constraint in BCon_x under the declared boundary, domain, and residue context.
PairwiseCompatible_x.role: Necessary component of the provisional joint constraint; not sufficient by itself.

HigherOrderCompatible_x.signature: HigherOrderCompatible_x(F_x; H_x, B_x, D_rel, R) : Prop
HigherOrderCompatible_x.definition: The completed family F_x satisfies every declared constraint in H_x whose arity is greater than two or whose scope is the orientation family as a whole.
HigherOrderCompatible_x.role: Captures incompatibilities that are invisible in pairwise checks.
domain_conditions: A higher-order constraint must be declared by D_rel or its governed compatibility specification.
The constraint applies only to the orientation family and assignment scope for which it is declared.
No higher-order constraint may be inferred solely from the existence of three orientations.
If no higher-order constraint is declared, HigherOrderCompatible_x remains unresolved rather than silently TRUE.

JointConstraint_x.signature: JointConstraint_x(F_x; BCon_x, H_x, B_x, D_rel, R) : Prop
JointConstraint_x.definition: JointConstraint_x holds iff PairwiseCompatible_x(F_x; BCon_x, B_x, D_rel, R) AND HigherOrderCompatible_x(F_x; H_x, B_x, D_rel, R).
JointConstraint_x.sufficiency_status: Pairwise compatibility is not declared sufficient unless a separate PairwiseSufficiency_x result is established for the declared domain.
JointConstraint_x.empty_family_guard: The empty family does not establish bounded realization even if the constraint evaluates vacuously.

revised_signature: PartialSufficiencyWitness_x(P_x, H_x, B_x, D_rel, R, RefRule_x, o_x) : Prop
revised_definition: PartialSufficiencyWitness_x holds iff P_x.Omega_x_undef is nonempty, o_x is in P_x.Omega_x_pos, admissibility provenance for o_x is present, Res_x(P_x; H_x, B_x, D_rel, R) is nonempty, and every rho_x in that resolution space satisfies RefDetermines_x(RefRule_x, rho_x, o_x; B_x, D_rel, R).
redundancy_correction: Preservation of AdmObs_x(o_x)=TRUE is required by construction because permitted resolutions cannot revise Omega_x_pos; the nontrivial test is reference-determining invariance across resolutions.

ref_orient_policy.uniqueness_guard: No global uniqueness claim is established unless RefRule_x is deterministic and the strong invariance condition is proved.

conditional_evaluation.statement: A provisional RefOrient output may enter delta_a evaluation as a tagged conditional candidate.

positive_realized_admission.statement: PartialSufficiencyWitness_x alone cannot produce a realized positive delta_a admission.

closure_routes.condition: Omega_x_undef becomes empty and total classification confirms the reference result.
A separate witness proves the same continuation satisfies Gamma_E, Gamma_R, Gamma_T, and Gamma_O and remains realization-admissible under every permitted resolution of Omega_x_undef.

delta_a_policy.future_entry_condition: Total resolution is sufficient but not necessary; either totality or full-continuation realization invariance may close the conditional candidate.

realization_invariance_candidate.name: ResolutionInvariantAdmission_x
realization_invariance_candidate.signature: ResolutionInvariantAdmission_x(q, P_x, B_x, D_rel, R, RefRule_x) : Prop
realization_invariance_candidate.definition: For every permitted resolution rho_x of P_x, q retains the same reference orientation and satisfies Gamma_E(q), Gamma_R(q), Gamma_T(q), and Gamma_O(q, rho_x).
realization_invariance_candidate.effect: Permits conversion from PARTIAL_REFERENCE_CONDITIONAL to a realized positive delta_a admission without requiring explicit classification of every unresolved orientation.

guards: Derivation context matches B_x, D_rel, and R.
Window context is aligned with B_x, D_rel, and R.
Window membership does not classify undefined orientations.

prohibited: Coerce undefined compatibility to TRUE or FALSE.
C_orient.threshold_guard: C_orient(F_x) >= tau implies JointlyCompatible_x only under a separate domain-scoped bridge theorem.

h_x_state.consequence: HigherOrderCompatible_x remains UNDEFINED; no positive PermittedResolution_x result may rely on completed higher-order compatibility.
h_x_state.empty_declaration_guard: H_x may be declared explicitly empty only after a scoped completeness review finds no applicable irreducible higher-order or whole-family constraints.

pairwise_sufficiency.definition: For every completed orientation family F_x admissible in the declared context, PairwiseCompatible_x(F_x; BCon_x, B_x, D_rel, R) implies HigherOrderCompatible_x(F_x; H_x, B_x, D_rel, R).
pairwise_sufficiency.blocked_while: H_x is undeclared and possible family-level sources remain unresolved.

binary_candidate_reconciliation.rule: Retain separate provenance records but deduplicate logical effect if both express the same admissibility condition.

preserved_guards: Undefined is neither TRUE nor FALSE.
Undefined orientations are never silently discarded.
The witness does not establish total classification or total orientation exclusion.
The witness does not require completed [Asym]_x or <S>_x.
The witness is evaluated before ProjectBounded.
No empty or unresolved family is interpreted as symmetry annihilation.

bounded_compatibility_test.purpose: Distinguish pairwise compatibility from family-level compatibility.
declared_constraints: Each pair {o_i,o_j} is compatible under PairwiseCompatible_x.
The declared family constraint permits at most two simultaneously TRUE orientations.

expected.interpretation: Pairwise compatibility does not imply joint compatibility.

related_existing_structures.relevance: Existing admissible orientation family used by an orientation-selection expression.
Existing admissible orientation window over a declared context.
Existing candidate metric for coherence among admissible orientation-pattern assignments.

repository_reconciliation.reconciliation_rule: Do not bind JointlyCompatible_x to O_adm, W_adm, or C_orient without a separate type and semantic compatibility review.

next_formalization: Perform bounded type-and-overlap analysis of FCI-004 and FCI-005 before binding any members into BCon_x.
